DDIA:Q2: Why does LSM need compaction?.detail: Inserts and updates are append-only, SSTables on disk grow and read queries degrade. Compaction merges and dedupes records in SSTables.

DDIA:Q4: What is a window in stream proc.detail: A window chunks records by processing time in order to process downstream. Windows can be tumbling, fixed, or sliding and contain watermarks that allow time for straggler records to queue.

DDIA:Q5: What problem do exactly-once se.detail: In the event of a failure in producer/broker/consumer, records should not be re-processed unless they can be guaranteed idempotent using a key or having broker keep track of consumer offsets.
